journal: Oxford University Press journals (shared preparation checklist)
snapshot_note: OUP's publisher-wide checklist for preparing a manuscript. OUP says its journals have different formatting requirements: word limits, structure, house style and keywords are on each journal's own page, which SubmitReady reads on every run.

sources.name: Oxford Academic: Preparing and submitting your manuscript

csl_style.note: Depends on the journal. References do not need the journal's style at first submission.

requirements.quote: Submit your paper as a Word or LaTeX file.

requirements.rule: Title, all author names and affiliations, and the corresponding author's email
requirements.quote: Remember to include a title, all author names and affiliations, and the corresponding author’s email address.

requirements.rule: Abstract without abbreviations or reference citations
requirements.quote: Provide an abstract that avoids abbreviations or reference citations.

requirements.rule: Define non-standard abbreviations at first use
requirements.quote: Define all non-standard abbreviations when they first appear.

requirements.rule: Numbered tables and figures, each with a legend
requirements.quote: Number tables and figures, ensure they all have a legend.

requirements.rule: High-resolution figures in a common format such as EPS or TIFF
requirements.quote: Figures should be high-resolution and in a common image format (e.g. .eps or .tif).

requirements.rule: Accurate references; the journal style is not needed at first submission
requirements.quote: You do not need to format references to the journal’s style when you first submit your paper.

requirements.rule: Acknowledgements, conflict of interest and funding (full funder names, grant numbers) at the end
requirements.quote: Include acknowledgements, conflict-of-interest declarations and details of funding sources and grant numbers at the end of your paper.

requirements.rule: Funding statement with full funder names as in the Crossref funder registry
requirements.quote: Cite all funding for your research, providing the grant number and the funder name.

requirements.rule: Follow the journal's data availability policy
requirements.quote: Check the journal’s Data Availability policy, and ensure your paper follows it.

requirements.rule: Tables editable, not images, with units in the headers and every table cited
requirements.quote: Supply any tables in an editable format (such as Microsoft Word), not as an image file.

requirements.rule: Supplementary files separate, cited in the text, self-explanatory names, at most 2 MB each
requirements.quote: Supplementary material files should be no larger than 2MB each.

requirements.rule: Insert symbols with Word's equation and symbol tools, not images
Check the journal's own page for word limits, structure, keywords and house style
